Chapter 01

The Story

The shared story of all our school friends.

🏫

How We Met

It began on the first day of school: new uniforms, nervous smiles and a classroom full of strangers who had no idea they would become friends for life.

🎒

Becoming Classmates

Sharing benches, borrowing pens and copying homework at the last minute. Little by little, classmates turned into friends and the class became a family.

🍱

Lunch Breaks & Games

Shared tiffin boxes, playground games, silly jokes and endless fun. The best stories were always written during the breaks.

😂

Funny Incidents

Funny moments with our teachers, unexpected pranks, giggles we could not hold back and school adventures we still laugh about.

📚

Exams & Study Moments

Last-minute revision, group study, nervous exam days and the relief afterwards. We stayed together through every test.

🤝

Helping Each Other

Small arguments and making up, sharing notes, cheering each other on and standing by one another in every school celebration.

Chapter 07 • The Final Chapter

OUR SCHOOL DAYS
→ FRIENDS FOREVER

AND OUR MEMORIES LIVE ON...

School ended. Paths changed. Life moved forward.

But somewhere in those classrooms, corridors and playgrounds, a group of friends created memories that can never be recreated in exactly the same way.

That's what makes it special.

Not because it was perfect. But because it was real.
